line: Night 2 I followed player_4, and they went to me, player_9. That's the only night result I have to share.
Trailseer here again. Night 2 I followed player_4, and it went to me, so player_4 visited player_9 that night. That could be a protection, so player_4 should say what they did.

Morning all. I have nothing new to claim, but I want to know why player_3 was pushing claims so hard on day 2. Player_9 and player_10 both fit the night 1 visit to player_5, so I'd like the Trailseer and Investigator to say whether anyone else saw that visit.
Last night I followed player_6 and saw them visit no one, so they are not the healer unless blocked. I'm still the trailseer, and I'll keep following the quiet players to find the pack.

Night 3 I followed player_6, and they visited no one. Nothing else from my side. player_8, you claimed a sentinel watch on player_10 on night 2 with no visitors; I'd like to hear your night 3 result as well.
Night 3 I followed player_10, and they visited player_2, who died that night. I'm the trailseer, and that's the only result I'm sharing. player_10, why did you visit player_2?
Night 3 I followed player_10 and saw them visit player_2, who was killed that night. player_2 claimed investigator, so player_10, why did you go to them?

Night 4 result from me: I followed player_5 and saw no visit in their name. Since the Necromancer's attacks show as the body's name, that doesn't clear player_5 either. Player_5, why did you vote me twice on day 2 with no reason?
Night 4 I followed player_5 and saw no visit in their name. That does not clear them, since a Necromancer's attack shows under the body's name, so player_5 still needs to explain their day 2 votes.
I'm the investigator. Night 1 I checked player_7: Not suspicious. Night 2 I checked player_1: Not suspicious, so player_1 isn't a wolf.

I'm counterclaiming trailseer, since player_5 is the only one on that role. Night 4 I followed player_1 and they visited no one. Night 3 I followed player_3, who visited no one. player_5 should say whether the night 4 follow on player_7 they planned is what they did.
I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_3 and they visited no one, which fits a roleblock. Night 2 I followed player_7 and they went to player_3.

player_8's vigilante story matches the record: player_5 was shot on night 4, and a roleblock on night 3 fits player_9 being the chanteuse. player_1 and player_4 have claimed nothing, and player_4 wouldn't name a role even when pressed. I'd vote player_4 today unless they give a checkable claim.

Player_8's night 4 shot on player_5 matches the record, so that claim fits so far. I'd like player_1 and player_4 to say what they did on nights 1 to 3, since one of you is the last unknown and we need checkable claims.

I'm not voting player_7 yet. The night 2 save is announced, so a healer exists, but the night 3 'precaution' only shows player_7 chose a target, not that the claim is true. player_5 offered a follow on a living player tonight; if they follow player_7 and see no visit, the night 3 story is false. That's a test we can all read tomorrow.

Player_6, you want a lynch on the healer based on a dead player's hidden role, which doesn't prove anything. The night 2 save on player_5 is confirmed, so player_7's claim has real support. I'd rather test it with a follow tonight than vote now, and I'm not voting today.

Still only one result on the table, and it's an unverified claim about player_7. Anyone holding a watch or follow, say whether you can test player_7 tonight rather than spending a vote on a claim nobody can check.

player_7, you protected player_5 on night 3, but nobody attacked player_5 that night. Player_3 was the one killed by the wolves. Why did your protection not go to player_3? Answer that and I can weigh your healer claim against player_5's trail.

player_7, you say you checked player_3 Not suspicious on night 2, but player_3 died that night to wolves and the serial killer. If you were checking the right player, that's a real clue about who was really killing. Also, player_1, which of you is telling the truth about the sentinel watch? Two people can't both be the only Investigator or Sentinel, so one of your claims needs a second source.

Oh, I'd like to see player_9 explain the healer claim. Their saves on nights 2 and 3 don't line up with the attack on player_10, and the night 2 visits to player_3 and player_7 suggest a block, not a heal. player_7's check is the only hard result we have, so I'd vote player_9 today.

Worth noting for player_5's claim: the wolves went for player_5 on night 2 and the healer saved them. Wolves usually hit the real trailseer, and a block on them that night fits too. So I lean toward believing player_5 for now, and tonight's follow result will settle it.

If we vote today I'd lean player_7. They're pushing for votes early while sitting on a check, and I'd rather see what the last check does before anyone is lynched. player_3, which player did you protect tonight, and what did your night 2 result say?
I'm the sentinel. Last night I watched player_7 and saw player_2 and player_3 visit them, which fits player_3 going to protect someone.
I'm the Sentinel, player_1. On night 2 I watched player_7 and saw two visitors, player_2 and player_3, so player_3's claim of visiting player_7 on night 2 is consistent with my result.
Right then, last night I watched player_7 and was roleblocked, so the watch didn't happen. That makes three blocks in a row on me, which means the Chanteuse is one of you two.
Night 5 I tried to watch player_7 and was roleblocked, so a wolf came to my door again. Three nights of blocks on my watches, and the Speculator is one of the two of you.
I'm the Trailseer. Night 4 I followed player_7, and it showed they went to me, so player_7 is worth testing against the save I got that night.
My night 4 follow: player_7 went to me, the night the healer saved me. Player_7, what did you do that night?
I'm the Trailseer. On night 1 I followed player_4 and they visited player_8, who died that night. Player_4, what were you doing there?
I'm player_5, the trailseer. On night 1 I followed player_4 and they visited player_8, who was killed that night. Player_4, explain that visit.
I am the vigilante. On night 4 I shot player_5, who was revealed as the illusionist, and I have one bullet left. I will shoot only when someone's claims clearly contradict each other.
I am the vigilante. My night 4 shot killed player_5, who was the illusionist, and I was roleblocked on night 3. I have one bullet left, so I want a clear contradiction before I use it.
Night 5 I was roleblocked, so my shot did not happen. The block came through player_9's body, which means the Necromancer is alive and is one of player_1, player_2 or player_4.

I'm the vigilante. I shot player_5 on night 4, and on night 5 I was roleblocked through the Chanteuse's body, so my shot at player_1 never happened. That block came from a dead wolf's body, so the Necromancer is alive and is one of the three of you.
I'm claiming Trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_4 and they went to player_8, which fits their reveal. Night 2 I was roleblocked, so I got nothing, and the wolves hit me but the healer saved me.
Night 4 I watched player_6, and the only visitor I saw was player_9. That is my one new result, and I'm not reading anything into it yet.
Night 4 I watched player_6, and player_9 came to them. That's all the watch shows, so no verdict yet, but player_6 is the one to press on where that visit came from.

I'm the sigilist, and last night my sigil on player_2 struck them down, so player_2 attacked someone on night 3. That fits the vigilante claim, and it means one of the wolves' targets was a Vigilante shot.

I'm the Investigator. Night 1 I checked player_5 (Not suspicious); night 2 I checked player_3 (Not suspicious), so player_3 wasn't a wolf. I still have one check and will use it where a vote needs it.
I'm the trailseer, as I said on day 2. On night 2 I followed player_6, and they visited no one.
I'm the trailseer. Night 2 I followed player_6, and they visited no one, so player_6 wasn't the one who went to me when the pack hit.
I'm the sentinel. On night 2 I watched player_9: visitors were player_1, player_4, player_7 and player_10, and player_10 was already dead, so someone used their body.
I'm the Sentinel. Night 2 I watched player_9: visitors were player_1, player_4, player_7 and player_10, who was already dead. So one of 1, 4 or 7 attacked and one saved.

I'm player_10, the investigator, as I said on day 2. Last night I checked player_4 and they read Not suspicious. That uses up both my checks.
I'm the investigator, as I said on day 2. Night 2 I checked player_4 and they read Not suspicious, so they are not a wolf.
Night 3 result, for the town: I watched player_7 and no one visited them, so player_7 was not attacked, protected, checked or blocked that night. That is my last watch used.
New from me: on night 3 I watched player_7 and no one visited them. So nobody attacked, protected, checked, blocked or followed player_7 that night.
I'm the sigilist. Last night my sigil struck down player_4, who was the chanteuse, so that's one wolf gone. I have one sigil left, and I'll only use it on someone who attacks.

I'm the sigilist. Night 3 I placed my sigil on player_4, and it struck them down, so they were an attacking wolf. That leaves the Illusionist as the only wolf alive, so the day 2 and 3 voting records matter more now.
I'm the trailseer. Night 3 I was roleblocked, so my follow on player_8 didn't happen, which means the Chanteuse came to me that night. My night 1 and 2 follows still stand.
I'm the trailseer. Night 3 I followed player_8, but I was roleblocked, so that follow did nothing and I learned nothing. Someone in the pack targeted me, so I'm a live target.
I'm the Sigilist, player_6. My night-4 sigil went on player_8 and had no effect, so player_8 did not attack that night.
I'm the sigilist. On night 4 I placed my sigil on player_8 and it had no effect, so player_8 did not attack anyone that night. Please keep that in mind when you weigh the night-4 kill.
I'm the Investigator. Last night I checked player_2 and they read Not suspicious, so they are not a wolf.
I'm the Investigator, already on record. Night 3 I checked player_2 and got Not suspicious, so player_2 is not a wolf.
I'm the Sentinel, and I'll share my watches now. Night 1 I watched player_2 and no one came to them; night 2 I watched player_8, and player_2, player_4, player_5 and player_9 all came to them.

player_3, a follow only shows where the target went. player_5's no-visit result on player_6 rules out player_6 as the carrier that night and says nothing about whether player_5 is genuine. I'd test player_5's claim against what player_6 and the others say they did, not against that result.

Checking player_5's night 1 trail against the record: player_4 was the serial killer and player_8 was stabbed that same night. That fits a real follow on player_4, and the wolves going after player_5 last night fits too. The wolves are among 1, 3, 6, 9, 10, so I would look at who pushed the early vote on player_4 without evidence.

player_9's healer claim stands now, and it is the only healer claim on the table. player_5, your two checks both read Not suspicious. Have you checked anyone since, and what would you do with the results?

player_3, you're the only living player who hasn't claimed anything. Which role are you, and what did you do on nights 1 to 4? Player_7, what are you planning to do with your sigils, and can your claim be checked?

Only player_7 has claimed a role, so the Investigator claim is the only hard thing on the table. Two clears can't be checked by anyone else, so I'd rather not vote on it blind. player_9, you have abstained every day: what is your read on player_7's claim? If nobody counters it, I'm leaning toward voting player_7 today.
I'll take player_7's claim as a working lead for now. If it's true, 2 and 3 are not wolves and the Chanteuse is 9. So I'd vote 9 today, and I want player_9 to give a reason for abstaining every day.

player_5 put the only name on the table and now says it had no basis, so I'd lean toward them today if we must vote. Players 7 and 9 have abstained three days running without a word, and I'd like a reason from each before the vote closes.

Right then, for what it's worth: I did nothing on night 2, so player_5's follow on me is accurate as far as I know. That makes their trail on player_4 more believable too. I'm not voting anyone today without a second source, and I'd like player_1 and player_10 to say what they'd actually test.

Right then, for the record: I did nothing on night 2, so player_5's follow on me is accurate. That fits their claim, but it doesn't prove the night 1 trail. I'd like someone to explain why the wolves went after player_5 if player_5 is a wolf-target and not the healer's protectee. Nobody has a clear vote from me yet.

player_7, you still haven't said which of your checks came when. You now say two checks, then a last one, then none, and you claimed a check on me on night 3 with nothing to back it. I'd vote player_7 on that. Players 2, 8 and 9 can clear themselves by saying what they'd have learned at night.

Player_2, you say checks are being hunted, yet nobody has checked anyone publicly. Whoever claims investigator should say who they checked and what came back, since a Suspicious read on someone like player_9 or player_7 would give us something to test. I'm not voting on a thin push either. Until someone gives a result, I'd abstain.

player_5, you say your follow shows player_4 went only to player_8. Did you see that visit on the night 1 result itself, or is that from a later check? If player_4 is lying about player_9, that's a clean contradiction we can test with a night 2 follow on player_4. I'd rather see player_4's visit pinned down than vote on a claim nobody can verify yet.

My night 1 follow of player_4 showed them going to player_8. Nights 2 and 3 my follow of player_9 was blocked both times, so the blocker is a wolf who doesn't want player_9 followed. player_9, you won't say what you did at night, so I'd vote you today unless you give a reason.

I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_4, and they went to player_8, the one stabbed that night. That fits player_4 being the serial killer. Nights 2 and 3 my follow of player_9 got blocked, so a wolf is blocking me. I'd vote player_9 today, since whoever keeps blocking my follow of them is protecting them.

My vote would be player_6. They have made no role claim, and when player_8 asked for the night 4 watch, they deflected rather than saying whether anyone came to them. Player_8's sentinel claim is still testable: their night 2 watch on player_10 can be checked against player_10's record if anyone else's data lines up.

player_8, your night 4 claim is the one to test. If you watched player_6 and player_9 came to them, then player_9 visited player_6, but player_9's will only covers night 3. Who else can confirm that visit? player_6, you say the watch would show who came to you, so answer directly: did anyone visit you on night 4, yes or no?

player_4's watch matches the wills, and the serial killer going after player_4 last night fits their account. player_2 still hasn't said what they did on any night, only asked for tests. If we vote today, I'd put it on player_2.

I'll say it plainly: I'm the sentinel. Night 1 I watched player_2 and no one came. Night 2 I watched player_8 and saw player_2, player_4, player_5 and player_9 come to them. player_2, you said you went to no one, but you were one of those visitors, so answer for that visit.

I'm the sentinel, and I'll say my night 2 result plainly: I watched player_8 and saw player_2, player_4, player_5 and player_9 come to them. player_2, you went to player_8, so 'no one' doesn't hold. Tell us why you went, the same as player_9 has to. My vote today is player_2 unless that changes.

player_9 says they went to player_8 on night 2, and player_8 says they were saved that night. If player_9 is the healer, that explains the save and gives us a way to test player_8's follow. player_9, are you the healer?

player_5's sigil claim lines up with the record: player_2 was struck down, and player_2 had shot someone. That makes player_5 more credible than the claims still being argued. 8 and 9 can't both be right about night 2, so I'd like each of them to say who visited them on night 1 and night 2.

player_9, your night 3 follow and player_8's night 3 watch should line up on who visited player_2 and player_7. Can you both say exactly what you saw? Also, player_6, we haven't heard your night results yet.

player_6's night 2 watch checks out against what I know: I was at player_8, and so was the serial killer, so player_4's 'visited nobody' was false. That leaves player_2 as the one I can't place. Someone came to player_8 that night to attack them, and player_2 is on the list. I'd vote player_2 today unless they explain that visit.

player_6's watch matches my night 2 visit to player_8, so their sentinel claim holds up for now. Player_2 also went to player_8 that night and has not said a word about a role. player_2, what did you do on night 2? If you are not the carrier or the Illusionist, you should be able to say.

Both wolves are gone, so the only killer left is the Necromancer, and by the record it is player_3 or player_6. Neither has claimed anything. I lean player_3 for the vote, but I want both to say what they did on night 5 before we lock it in.

Both wolves are down, so the Necromancer is player_3 or player_6. player_3 has abstained twice and claimed nothing. I'd vote player_3 unless player_6 gives a reason to prefer them. player_6, what did you do on nights 4 and 5?

Player_9's night 1 sighting matches player_10's will, so I'm inclined to trust their trailseer claim. Player_8 has no result to check after the block. I'd vote player_1 for now: they pushed player_6 as necromancer with nothing behind it. Low confidence, but I'd rather see a concrete reason than a silent-player theory.

player_2, you have said you have nothing new, yet you are one of only two roles left for you: Healer or Serial Killer. Which of those are you, and what did you do on night 4? If you were the Healer, you protected player_4 that night, which would fit the save on record. Name your night action so we can test it.

Player_2, you have named no night action for night 3 and only asked others to speak first. Tell us plainly what you did, and whether you were the one who saved player_4 on night 4 or not. Player_8 and player_9, you have said nothing yet; state your role claim or your night result so we can weigh the Chanteuse search.

player_5, you have said your follow on player_9 was blocked twice, so pick a new target and post where they went. If the claim holds, that is more useful than arguing about who blocked you. Also, the vote on player_9 is only a guess right now, so I want a second source before anyone is lynched.

player_9 keeps refusing to say where they went, and player_5 keeps pointing at the same block. A roleblock tells us a Chanteuse exists, not who it is. I'd rather see player_5 post a fresh follow on a new target than argue about the blocks again.

I would rather not rush a vote on thin evidence. player_9 says healer, but a healer's save on player_2 cannot be confirmed by anyone, and player_7's Suspicious read sits on the only hard result we have. I'd like player_7 and player_9 each to name the night-two result they expect the other to show, so we can see who contradicts the record first.

On night 2 my watch on player_1 showed player_2, player_3, player_4 and player_9 coming to them, so yes, several others besides player_4. player_3 was already dead, so that visit was a body used by the Necromancer. Nothing new on player_1 beyond that.

player_8, yes. My night 2 watch on player_1 saw four visitors: player_2, player_3, player_4 and player_9. No one else. player_3 was already dead, so that visit came through the body. So the Chanteuse's block was not the only visit player_1 got that night.

player_3, my night 3 check went nowhere I'll give out. I checked player_5 on night 2 and they read Suspicious, which the record already backs, so I'm holding to that. Night 3 is my business for now. If you think one of us is lying, name the contradiction in the record rather than the claim itself.

player_3, I checked player_5 on night 2 and got Suspicious, so that's my claim and I'm sticking to it. I didn't check anyone on night 3 or 4 that I'm sharing. player_6, the sigilist claim is yours to back up; if you hold both sigils, a sigil on the right attacker would prove it, so I'd like to see it used.

player_1, you saw me go to player_7 on night 3, and that is right. I was the sigilist, and I placed my sigil on player_7 that night. It had no effect, since player_7 did not attack anyone. If you are the trailseer, that fits; if someone else is the sigilist, they should say so now.

player_1, you say I visited player_7 on night 3. That's right, I went to player_7, but as the sigilist: I placed a sigil on them, and it had no effect because they didn't attack anyone. That leaves one of us as the trailseer and one as the sigilist, so player_1, what did you see when you followed me?

I'm player_7, and I wasn't roleblocked as far as I know; I placed nothing on night 1, so I have nothing to show. Player_8's follow is the only result we have, and it's worth testing: if player_8 really followed player_10 to me, the block is on my side. I'd rather we hear from anyone else holding a night-1 result before voting.

player_3, I placed nothing on night 1, and I was not told I was roleblocked, so I can't confirm or deny player_8's account from my side. I have no result to trade. If player_8's follow is right, the block landed on me and I'm Town. I'd rather we see whether anyone else has a conflicting night 1 result before we pin anything on the Trailseer claim.

player_6, you say both your sigils are still in hand after three nights. A Sigilist who never places one has nothing to show, so why claim it now? My night 3 sigil on player_7 had no effect, and I can't prove that to you any more than you can prove your empty hand. Player_1's follow is the test, and I'm not going to be lynched on your word alone.

player_6, you say both your sigils are still in hand, but a Sigilist who never placed one has no result to test. Which players did you consider, and why none? My night 3 sigil on player_7 had no effect, and that is my whole story. player_1's report of my visit fits that night, so I have no reason to change it.

I didn't block anyone last night, player_7. I'm the Vigilante, and I held my fire on night 5. player_4, you say a wolf blocked you three nights running, but nobody else can see that, so it's just your word. If you're the real Sentinel, why didn't you watch anyone who could be checked? I'd rather vote on that than on the blocks.

player_7, I'm not claiming a night role, so I won't name my visits. I didn't see who blocked player_4, and I can't check their watch from here. player_4's claim is the only thing on the table about last night, so I'd like to see whether they name the blocker or just say they were stopped.

Yes, I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_10 and saw them go to player_7. Night 2 I followed player_3 and saw no visits. Night 3 I followed player_9 and saw them go to player_5, which fits their healer claim. player_7, did you get a roleblock message on night 1?

player_2, yes, I saw player_10 go to player_7 on night 1. It's my follow, so it can't be checked, but it fits the chanteuse dying that night and player_7 seeing nothing. I'd rather not guess the reason beyond that. Nights 2 and 3 are in my earlier posts, so don't read more into them.

I followed player_4 on night 1 and they went to player_8, not player_9. player_8 was the one stabbed that night. player_4, what did you do when you visited player_8? A visit to a dead player that night needs an explanation. I'll follow someone new tonight.

I'm the Trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_4, and they went to player_8, not player_9. player_8 was stabbed that night, so player_4 is the one I'd like explained. player_4, why did you visit player_8?
